title: AndroDR IOC Entry
description: Schema for a single entry in any ioc-data/*.yml file. Covers two legitimate entry shapes surfaced by the Task 1a audit: (1) a threat-IOC entry keyed on 'indicator' (used by c2-domains.yml, cert-hashes.yml, malware-hashes.yml, package-names.yml), and (2) a known-good allowlist entry keyed on 'packageName' (used by popular-apps.yml). Files that have no 'entries' list at all (e.g. known-oem-prefixes.yml, which uses structural prefix-group keys) are handled by the validator's early-return path and are not reached by this schema.

threatIocEntry.description: Threat IOC: a malicious indicator (domain, hash, package name) with provenance.

knownGoodAppEntry.description: Known-good allowlist entry: a legitimate popular Android app whose permission usage should not generate low-confidence findings.
